name: BF16
description: Unquantized 16-bit floating point (8-bit exponent, 7-bit mantissa); highest accuracy, largest memory footprint

name: W8A8
description: 8-bit integer weights and activations (INT8); weight memory is roughly half of BF16; requires official quantized weights

name: W4A8
description: 4-bit weights with 8-bit activations (W4A8); weight memory is half of W8A8; suited to memory-constrained deployments

name: W8A16
description: 8-bit weights with 16-bit floating-point activations (FP16/BF16); activations are not quantized, trading memory for accuracy

name: MXFP8
description: OCP microscaling floating-point format: FP8 (E4M3) elements sharing one E8M0 scale factor per 32 elements; used by the 950 generation, usually paired with MXFP4 weights (4-bit weights / 8-bit activations)
